row:
Reaseheath College is the leading landbased College in the UK.  Based in Cheshire  the College has an enviable setting amongst 500 acres of farms, parklands, lake, woodland and sports facilities, including our own golf course, you can't help feeling at home at Reaseheath.

At Reaseheath you can find courses available in the following subject areas: Adventure Sports, Agriculture, Animal Management, Business & Events Management, Construction, Countryside, Engineering, Equine, Food Industry, Floristry, Greenkeeping & Sports Turf, Horticulture, Motor Vehicle, Sports Studies, Apprenticeships, Access to HE, Entry & Foundation Studies
